headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Linn of Mercy and Mooring County Fronts
war_summary: Fierce structural contests have surged across Linn of Mercy and Mooring County over the past three hours, with each sector registering six strategic base actions in the latest two-hour window. Fighting in Linn of Mercy remains centered on Lathair, inflicting over fifteen hundred Warden casualties against nearly seven hundred Colonial losses in two hours. In Mooring County, sharp engagements around Wiccwalk and The Wind Hills have driven enlistments and casualty rates upward as the sector balance remains contested. Meanwhile, Stonecradle continues to endure heavy combat, logging three base events and over thirty-two hundred combined casualties across World's End and The Cord. Farther west, Nevish Line has witnessed a sudden spike in engagement, consuming over seventeen hundred casualties in two hours despite no recorded base flips. Weathered Expanse continues to bleed heavily with nearly thirty-six hundred casualties over two hours amidst a lull in base conversions, while operations in Fisherman’s Row have ground to a halt following earlier widespread turmoil.
